id: title:jonmcwest:fold call chains and draw tree lines in the trace dialog

review.posthog_relevance: Adds UI controls and rendering support for chain folding and pinned ancestors in the Tracing Dialog, potentially changing the visual representation of span trees.
review.reason: The chunk includes implementation hunks for chain-toggle actions, chain-row wrappers, and row construction algorithms, not just tests or types. P1.F4.H5 and P1.F4.H6 connect the chain-toggle action and pinned ancestors bar. P1.F9.H2 replaces the row builder with a structured algorithm, changing how rows and connector lines are constructed. P1.F9.H1 adds supporting types and helpers
